notes.title: UPDATE!! Localization + Matchmaking + New Costumes
notes.content:
v2017112201

Localized in 17 different languages (English, German, Danish, Spanish, Finnish, French, Italian, Japanese, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Brazilian, Portuguese, Russian, Swedish, Turkish, and Chinese)

Matchmaking update: We reorganized the matchmaking system so that players will have a better chance at finding a match. There is no more ranked toggle-- all online games found through matchmaking are now ranked. Match settings have been locked to streamline the menu screens. 

None of the matchmaking updates change the way “invite a friend” works, so that still behaves just like local multiplayer.

We’ve added a few new (cosmetic) costume pieces, which unlock as you play online games and against strangers. You can change your costume from the Online menu.

“No Gore” confetti effect

Bug Fixes:
Fixed Arcade Highscores
Longsword now blocks while walking
Low stance Dagger now blocks slides
Added invisible wall to left side of center Airship room
Other things that I can’t remember


Thanks to our Discord community https://discord.gg/nidhogg for finding some of these!

notes.title: New Level: "PAX Place"
notes.content:
We had a lot of fun showing off Nidhogg 2 at PAX West last week. It was great meeting fans and watching new players get into the game. We had a cozy corner booth as a part of the [url=http://indiemegabooth.com/]Indie MegaBooth[/url] which is a huge block of indie games on the main floor of the convention. We were selling some T-Shirts, Hats, and the game soundtrack on CD and Cassette tapes. You can get all of that stuff online now (even a pink vinyl) through our [url=https://nidhogg.bandcamp.com/merch]bandcamp page[/url]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26430364/8979388e313e9b67fc681b09fe0ae6b097fde237.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26430364/9b3ac820fa4d69ec5c135a385a091d0581691a63.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26430364/c8d68d36cf7cd7682c313c8291ba19c6bf489230.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26430364/7a7d6b63fe626b589b0a848d4dac78203d45ec94.jpg[/img]

Nidhogg 2 was secretly chosen to be the final round of the [url=https://twitter.com/Official_PAX/status/904865148137033729]Omegathon[/url]  We wanted to do something special for the competition, so we made a PAX/Seattle themed level called "PAX Place" (like Pikes place.... get it??) complete with dead fish, a gum wall, lots of coffee paraphernalia, and a space needle in distress. 
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26430364/690d391c9fc0bf7fe562ffc65ab6742c47b5cf89.jpg[/img]

The competition was held at Benaroya Hall, normally the venue for the Seattle Symphony Orchestra. It was a packed house and the first round went to sudden death... only I somehow forgot to add the sudden death screen! Who would have thought that competitions could go to sudden death. This has to be an eSports first ːwormheadː  Luckily that was the only oversight in the build so the rest of the competition took place on other levels.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26430364/3ae93a40b3660541895db6a39a56724575f51164.jpg[/img]

We've updated the Steam build, so now you too can do battle in PAX Place! We even have our Nidhogg booth in there, so if you couldn't make the con, you can visit it in ~VIRTUAL (2d) REALITY~

We plan to add content like this regularly. Still figuring out a firm schedule, but once a month seems likely! Don't forget to join our official [url=https://discord.gg/nidhogg]Discord server[/url]

v2017090501
- added a new local and online multiplayer level "pax place"
- added "pax place" sudden death screen
- added a "no gore" option

See you on the battlefield!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26430364/e7b979f8e53f3ee62b64db9dbdbed2359c5e327c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Hotfix v2017082501
notes.content:
Hotfix v2017082501 (latest)
- steam screenshot support
- fixed text chat blocking input after quitting online mode
- changed some main menu ui elements
- back button backs out title submenus properly
- matchmaking improvements
- added pixel perfect window size preferences (you can still drag the window to resize)

ːwormheadː Trading cards are now live! ːn2ː

Hotfix v2017082001
- fixed crash with error message talking about footsteps
- fixed memory leak
- added summary of match rules to character screen
- f12 no longer resets the game

Hotfix v2017081601
- more fixes for matchmaking (players getting stuck on "connecting" screen)

Hotfix v2017081501
- fixed some matchmaking issues preventing players from connecting
